concept: SQS: buffering bursts between API Gateway and Lambda
tests: How to smooth request bursts and protect the downstream DB when Lambda hits its concurrency limit.
expected: Put an SQS queue between API Gateway and Lambda — decouples ingest rate from processing rate; the queue buffers peaks and the DB isn't overwhelmed. Triggers: "throttling", "smooth bursts", "avoid overwhelming downstream database".
why_not: Raising the API Gateway burst limit lets more load through instead of smoothing it; provisioned concurrency removes cold starts but doesn't buffer; an NLB provides no queue.
